title: ₹20 Lakh Ki Innova Corporate Rent Pe Lagayi: Mahine Ke Ant Mein Kitna Bachta Hai?
description: The ₹745/km contract-bus reel got 8.7M views and 524k likes on 'predictable income from a vehicle'. Trucks and sleeper buses are covered, but a small cab fleet is the entry point for most viewers.
text:
# FACT SHEET: Buying one Innova Crysta or Ertiga and attaching it to a corporate or travel-company contract

**Status:** I found good data on purchase price, EMI, permit fee, insurance, GST, driver salary and attachment payouts. I found nothing usable on idle days, break-even time, state road tax for yellow-plate vehicles, or diesel price. Those gaps are listed at the end. I have not filled them with guesses.

## 1. What it costs to buy

- 2026 Innova Crysta GX / GX Fleet 7-seater is ₹19,72,000 ex-showroom. GX+ is ₹21,15,000. VX is ₹24,93,000. ZX is ₹26,63,000. GX / GX Fleet – Rs 19,72,000; GX+ – Rs 21,15,000; VX – Rs 24,93,000; ZX – Rs 26,63,000 [https://www.team-bhp.com/news/2026-toyota-innova-crysta-launched-rs-1972-lakh]
- Sites differ slightly, with some showing ₹19.95 lakh as the base. ₹19.95 Lakh base, up to ₹27.10 Lakh [https://www.zigwheels.com/toyota-cars/innova-crysta/]
- Delhi on-road price for the base GX 8-seater is ₹24,68,826. That is ₹19,77,000 ex-showroom + ₹3,86,365 RTO + ₹1,05,461 insurance [https://www.zigwheels.com/toyota-cars/innova-crysta/on-road-price-delhi/]
- Note: these are private-registration on-road figures. A commercial registration will differ, and I found no commercial on-road figure.
- Bangalore on-road price for the base variant is ₹25,76,213. RTO ₹4,79,212 [https://www.zigwheels.com/toyota-cars/innova-crysta/on-road-price-bangalore/]
- EMI examples listed on the same pages:
  - ₹39,917 per month for the ₹21,15,000 ex-showroom variant (Delhi, on-road ₹26,37,258) [https://www.zigwheels.com/toyota-cars/innova-crysta/on-road-price-delhi/]
  - ₹37,210 per month for a Bangalore variant [https://www.zigwheels.com/toyota-cars/innova-crysta/on-road-price-bangalore/]
  - Loan tenure is not stated on these pages.
- Loan terms: down payment is usually 20-30% of on-road price; interest rate 9.25-11.5%, depending on credit score [https://www.zigwheels.com/toyota-cars/innova-crysta/on-road-price-delhi/]
- **Cheaper option:** the Maruti Ertiga Tour M is priced at ₹9.95 Lakh to ₹10.93 Lakh ex-showroom [https://www.cardekho.com/maruti/ertiga-tour]
  - Delhi on-road price starts at ₹11.22 lakh. ex-showroom 9,67,820 + RTO 1,05,947 + insurance 48,373 [https://www.zigwheels.com/maruti-suzuki-cars/ertiga-tour/on-road-price-delhi]
  - Mileage is 18.04 kmpl on petrol [https://www.cardekho.com/maruti/ertiga-tour]. The CNG version is rated 26.08 km/kg. [https://www.cardekho.com/maruti/ertiga-tour]
- **Insider fact:** the Crysta is on its way out. The 2026 refresh is most likely the last, and the MPV is set to bow out in 2027 [https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news/2026-toyota-innova-crysta-launched-at-rs-21-15-lakh-439877]
- Converting a private car to a taxi: one source says RTO endorsement, commercial insurance, permit and yellow plate cost ₹25,000 to ₹45,000 and take three to six weeks [https://www.buyselltaxi.com/blog/used-taxi-price-list-india-2026]
- Another source puts conversion at ₹15,000–25,000 and 30–60 days [https://www.buyselltaxi.com/blog/buy-innova-for-taxi-india]
- These two sources conflict, so say "roughly ₹15,000 to ₹45,000, depending on source".

## 2. Permit and tax

- All India Tourist Permit (AITP) fee under the 2023 rules is ₹30,000 a year for a 5–9 seat MPV (Innova, Ertiga). The quarterly fee is ₹9,000. ₹30,000 a year, or ₹9,000 a quarter [https://www.buyselltaxi.com/blog/aitp-all-india-tourist-permit-delhi]
- A state contract-carriage or taxi permit costs only ₹1,000–5,000 depending on state and category [https://www.buyselltaxi.com/blog/t-permit-cost-renewal-validity-india]
- The AITP is worthwhile only for inter-state running. AITP is "worthwhile only if you run inter-state" [https://www.buyselltaxi.com/blog/t-permit-cost-renewal-validity-india]
- There is also a ₹1,000 a year authorisation fee. Authorization (₹1,000/year) is mandatory for all operators [https://www.smcinsurance.com/rto/articles/all-india-tourist-permit-aitp-taxi-fees]
- **Insider fact:** the AITP fee is zero for electric vehicles. No permit fee for battery-operated tourist vehicles or those running on methanol or ethanol [https://www.bankbazaar.com/driving-licence/permit-fees-of-motor-vehicles-in-India.html]
- **GST on the monthly bill:**
  - The 5% rate continues, with restricted input tax credit (ITC). The full-ITC option rose from 12% to 18% on 22 Sep 2025. 5% concessional rate continues; full-ITC option increased from 12% to 18% [https://busy.in/gst-rates/taxi/]
  - This applies where fuel is included in the rent. [https://busy.in/gst-rates/cab-service/]
  - Insider fact: when a non-company owner (proprietor or partnership) bills a company at 5%, the company pays the GST, not the owner. Renting from a non-body-corporate to a body corporate is under reverse charge (RCM) [https://www.taxtmi.com/article/detailed?id=14397]
  - At 5%, ITC on the vehicle purchase itself is not available. Purchase of a motor vehicle: ITC is restricted [https://taxguru.in/goods-and-service-tax/gst-renting-motor-vehicles-operators-driving-tax-maze.html]
- **Not found:** state road/commercial tax for yellow-plate vehicles. It varies by state. Do not quote a number.

## 3. Money coming in: what a contract pays

- **Attachment payouts (company supplies the client; the owner supplies the car):**
  - Midtown Travel Studio (Mumbai, T-permit): Innova Crysta ₹50,000 a month fixed, driver and fuel managed by the company. Innova Crysta: ₹50K
